subject: Kiosk kit repackaging & assembly instructions
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: LuxePromo Orders <orders@luxepromo.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kiosk kit repackaging — initial specs & timeline

Hi Ella,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the sample boxes last week. We're moving forward with a small in-venue kiosk drop for the Redwood Summit (Aug 12-13) and need LuxePromo to repackage 1,250 kits into venue-ready kiosks. Key asks:

- Split SKUs per kit: 3x sticker sheets, 1x embroidered patch, 1x charger tag, 1x lanyard.
- Replace the polybag with a resealable matte pouch (no clear plastic on the front).
- Add a 2" hangtag for VIP kits (50 kits) with serial sticker affixed.
- Labeling: shipping label on outer case only; each kit must have a small content sticker (content: KIT-A) on the bottom seam.
- Include a printed one-page insert with usage instructions (we will provide final PDF by 7/30).

Please confirm:
- Whether you can do the resealable matte pouches and apply serial labels for VIPs.
- Lead time for packing 1,250 kits and earliest pickup date.
- Any changes to what you quoted previously; please attach updated PO/invoice and packing plan.

Attachments: sample_pack_plan_v1.pdf (for reference)

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Ella Martinez <ella@luxepromo.co>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kiosk kit repackaging — initial specs & timeline

Hi Aditya,

Thanks — we can take this on. A few clarifying notes and an updated plan attached.

1) Pouches: we can source a matte, resealable pouch with a 4-color front print. Lead time for that material is 6 business days once PO is confirmed; we can also use a white matte pouch (no front window) if you need faster turnaround. See sample_pouch_spec.png attached.

2) VIP serials: we can apply serialized tamper stickers to 50 VIP hangtags. We will need the serial list in CSV format by end of day 7/30 to guarantee accuracy.

3) Packing throughput & timeline: with current capacity, packing 1,250 kits will take 5 full production days (2 packing lines). Earliest pickup we can schedule is Aug 5 (local pickup from warehouse). If you need earlier, we can add a third line at an incremental labor charge (quoted in the invoice).

4) Changes to price: attached invoice_draft_567.pdf reflects the pouch upgrade, serialization, and labor for 2 packing lines. Total is $18,420 + freight.

5) QC & photos: we will provide pre-shipment photos of 10 random kits per pallet and a final packing list CSV (packing_list_LuxePromo_789.csv).

Attached: kiosk_pack_plan_v2.pdf (detailed counts/layout), sample_pouch_spec.png, invoice_draft_567.pdf.

Let me know if that works and whether you want us to book FedEx Freight for pickup (we can do DDP or you can supply your account).

Best,

Ella Martinez
Operations Manager | LuxePromo
ella@luxepromo.co
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0122

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ella Martinez <ella@luxepromo.co>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kiosk kit repackaging — initial specs & timeline

Thanks Ella — this looks good overall. A few strategic tweaks before we lock PO:

- Confirm VIP hangtags should be physically separated and packed into 50 "VIP" envelopes inside the top tray of the kit (so the kiosk ambassador can hand them out quickly).
- Add a printed voucher card (single-sided, 2.75x4.25) with a unique code to 200 of the kits (these are promo codes; we will provide a file). Codes should be placed beneath the insert so they are visible when opening.
- Please do the 10 pre-shipment photos per pallet and upload them to the Drive link in the HubSpot deal once available.
- Dylan: please confirm receiving window and whether venue will accept palletized crates (Hannah from Venue Events is looped on logistics; Ella, please coordinate crate size if needed).

If all good, Aditya and I are okay to approve the invoice as updated. Please confirm final pickup date and whether you will bill freight or we should provide a FedEx account.

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa Cole
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Ella Martinez <ella@luxepromo.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kiosk kit repackaging — initial specs & timeline

Marissa / team — all set. Final confirmations below:

- VIP hangtags will be separated into 50 labeled VIP envelopes and placed in the top tray.
- We will include 200 voucher cards with unique codes (please upload the .csv to the HubSpot deal link or reply with the file by 7/30).
- Packing photos will be uploaded to the Drive link by Aug 3 after palletization.
- Pickup scheduled: Aug 5, 09:00 local. We have quoted freight to your account if you choose to supply FedEx details; otherwise we will bill DDP and attach the manifest.
- Final invoice attached as paid/unpaid draft; please confirm PO number and billing contact so we can finalize.

Attachments: packing_list_LuxePromo_789.csv

We will send the final manifest and pallet photos on Aug 3. Let me know if you want us to book FedEx (we have a standard corporate account and can schedule).

Best,

Ella Martinez
Operations Manager | LuxePromo
ella@luxepromo.co
